title: 夺冠蜂巢 Agent Key
description: Agent Key 仅存储在本机，连接夺冠蜂巢时注入到 MCP Server 环境变量中，不会上传至云端。获取方式：登录夺冠蜂巢 → 设置 → 创建 Agent。
description_en: The Agent Key is stored locally only. It is injected into the MCP Server environment when connecting to Duoguan Fengchao, and is never uploaded to the cloud. To obtain: log in to Duoguan Fengchao → Settings → Create Agent.
docLabel_en: How to get an Agent Key?

fields.label: Agent Key
fields.description: 以 ca_live_ 开头的完整凭证字符串。不要使用 Key ID、邀请码或网页登录 Token。
fields.description_en: Full credential string starting with ca_live_. Do not use Key ID, invite code, or web login token.
